mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate, as measured by the current level of FEDFUNDS, compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of the absolute level of the rate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of all periods when FEDFUNDS is observed, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.5%, as measured by UNRATE, signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and stock valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 50th percentiles, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95, as measured by INDPRO, indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and stock valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total nonfarm employment, as measured by PAYEMS, reflects robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of the absolute level of employment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of all periods when PAYEMS is observed, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index above 220, as measured by CPIAUCSL, signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market contraction below 600 thousand units, as measured by HOUST, indicates weak residential construction that reduces economic activity and corporate revenues, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST falls below 600, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 13500 billion dollars, as measured by GDPC1, indicates a strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and stock valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 13500, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
